newsitem.title: USA: Uruguay buys one mln bbls Venezuelan Mesa-30 crude.
newsitem.headline: Uruguay buys one mln bbls Venezuelan Mesa-30 crude.

text.p: Uruguay's state oil refiner ANCAP bought one million barrels of Mesa-30 crude from Lagoven, a subsidiary of state Petroleos de Venezuela, in its latest tender, trade sources said on Friday.
ANCAP paid between $3.25 and $3.30 a barrel under benchmark West Texas Intermediate/Cushing on a delivered basis, the sources said.
Lagoven will deliver the crude around July 19-27.

ANCAP received some 30 offers from 13 different companies in this tender, three times the number of offers it usually receives. The turnout reinforced widely held perceptions that the market is oversupplied.
Uruguay rarely buys Venezuelan crude in its regular crude tenders, although ANCAP often purchases Venezuelan asphaltic crude BCF-24 in direct negotiations, the sources said.
"Venezuela offered a very competitive price," a trade source said.
Most Venezuelan crude is exported to the United States.
In its last tender, ANCAP bought one million barrels of Iranian Light at a price related to dated Brent for delivery in the second half of June.
